synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.

synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.
